protocol.restitution_combination: min(a,b) -> only green-agent <-> static bounces amplify

easy_contrast.definition: search-split instances repeat_random hits within 6000 of 262144 steps

mechanisms.name: Death-aware checkpoint chaining (survival go-explore)
mechanisms.what: Archive only non-terminal states, key slots by (depth-since-reset, coarse novelty); restore preferentially to the deepest surviving states and suppress the action that ended the last episode.
mechanisms.computable_from: the harness `done` flag passed to archive(), feats time_frac, dyn_pos/vel
mechanisms.why: In the maze/platformer levels every one of the 11 held actions ends the episode by hazard contact in 13-19 steps, so the whole 262k budget is spent on ~15k restarts of a half-second episode; depth is only reachable by chaining checkpoints.

mechanisms.name: Full-episode coherent holds (macro length swept to the 256-step horizon)
mechanisms.what: Sweep hold length over {8,32,96,256} instead of capping at 12 (sticky-random) / 20 (macrosweep); one action, or one 2-action alternation, held for the whole episode.
mechanisms.computable_from: nothing but the action index and a step counter
mechanisms.why: For thrust-to-weight near 1 the climb needs 57-172 steps of uninterrupted thrust; 37/45 thrust-actuated misses need a hold longer than sticky-random can emit and 25/45 longer than a macrosweep macro.

mechanisms.name: Velocity-aligned drive ("keep pushing the way it is already moving")
mechanisms.what: Every H steps score each action by the sign of the change it produced in the projection of dyn velocity on its own previous direction; keep the action while the projection grows.
mechanisms.why: Wheeled and thruster bodies need net drift of 0.4-4.7 m; sticky-random reverses every <=12 steps and nets ~0 displacement (held actions travel a median 0.45 m in one episode, and that is the *best* of 11).

mechanisms.name: Energy ratchet with restore-to-max-energy
mechanisms.what: Key the archive by a mechanical-energy proxy E = v_max^2 + 2 g y of the dynamic bodies; restore to the top-E slots and only keep an action while E increases.
mechanisms.why: ANOMALY needs 12 m/s where free fall from the box top gives 9.5 m/s; the amplification is a *multiplicative* ladder (restitution 1.6, combined as min(a,b), so only green<->static bounces gain) so states must be chained by energy, not by novelty. The best single held action reaches a median 7.0 m/s (max 10.7).

mechanisms.name: Resonant square-wave drive (period sweep)
mechanisms.what: Alternate two opposed actuator actions with the half-period swept over {1,2,4,...,128} steps per worker; keep the period whose amplitude/energy grows fastest.
mechanisms.computable_from: action indices + step counter; scored by the same E as M4
mechanisms.why: 43 misses have a jointed agent driven by motors (pendulum/cartpole/unicycle/arm/walker). A constant hold saturates against the joint; only a drive matched to the pendulum period pumps amplitude.

mechanisms.name: Static-shape contact enumeration
mechanisms.what: Enumerate the active static (inverse_mass == 0) shapes; for each, steer the nearest dynamic body toward it with bang-bang on the sign of the position error and hold until contact or termination; then move to the next.
mechanisms.computable_from: feats poly_pos/circle_pos/poly_active + which shapes never move (zero velocity over a window)
mechanisms.why: Every DISARMED and TUNNEL target and 8 SHORTCUT targets are static shapes 0.6-3.0 m away; the witness is literally "touch that shape", and touching every static shape in turn is oracle-blind.

mechanisms.name: Actuator saturation / self-folding
mechanisms.what: Cycle all motor-binding actions in the SAME direction for the whole episode so every joint is driven to its stop simultaneously (and the mirrored version).
mechanisms.computable_from: action indices only (2 actions per motor binding)
mechanisms.why: 11 SHORTCUT misses put the injected goal on a link of the agent's own linkage 0.38-0.87 m from the green body: the witness fires when the mechanism folds onto itself, which needs all joints at their stops at once.

mechanisms.name: Boundary seeking
mechanisms.what: Compute the world box from the shapes that never move, and drive the nearest dynamic body at the nearest box face; hold until it crosses or the episode ends.
mechanisms.why: OOB is 148/337 of the pool and 88 of the 149 misses; the witness is purely "a moving body leaves the box", and no current tester has any term that points outward.

mechanisms.name: Termination avoidance (goal shunning)
mechanisms.what: After the level has been won once, penalise actions that reduce green-blue distance, so workers keep exploring past the win instead of being reset.
mechanisms.computable_from: feats green_blue_dist and the reward/done seen by the harness
mechanisms.why: 36 misses lie in levels where at least one held action ends the episode with a win at ~200 steps; winning truncates exactly the long-horizon rollouts in which OOB/ANOMALY witnesses live.
